name: PipeStreamr
description: WhatsApp (and more) via the PipeStreamr passthru. Outbound replies go through PipeStreamr's /api/v1/messages/send; inbound messages arrive as PipeStreamr webhooks. Point your PipeStreamr project webhook at <daemon>/webhook/pipestreamr. This channel's API key and webhook secret are stored as its own scoped secrets (in the Keys tab, under this channel) — not as account-wide keys.

settings.label: PipeStreamr integration ID
settings.help: The PipeStreamr integration UUID for this channel. Inbound webhooks are routed to this channel by matching it, and replies are sent back through it. Find it in PipeStreamr under the integration's settings.

settings.label: WhatsApp number (label)
settings.help: Optional — the WhatsApp number behind this integration, shown for reference. Routing uses the integration ID, not this number.

settings.label: PipeStreamr API key
settings.help: Bearer key for PipeStreamr's send API. Stored as this channel's own secret, not an account-wide key.

settings.label: Webhook signing secret
settings.help: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify inbound webhooks. Set the same value on your PipeStreamr webhook.

settings.label: API base URL (optional)
settings.help: Override only for a self-hosted PipeStreamr deployment. Leave blank for the hosted service.

settings.label: Persona
settings.help: The persona that answers inbound messages on this channel. Leave blank to use the orchestrator-agent, which delegates to specialist personas as needed.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: Model the persona runs with. Leave blank for the daemon default.
